intent: Review a network interface's connection history.
actions: Start signed in as an administrator on the filtered interface list, with interfaces on two devices previously connected by a cable that has since been deleted through NetBox's native cable-deletion path.
Open one of those interfaces, wait for it to load, and inspect the Connection panel.
Open the Changelog tab and wait for the listed changes to load.
Open the timestamp of the latest Updated Interface entry and inspect its connection change details.
